UnaMentis - API Provider Detail View
Comprehensive information about each LM API provider
Part of UI/UX (TDD Section 10)

UnaMentis - Barge-In Tuning ("nerd knobs")
On-device, runtime-adjustable barge-in parameters. The point is to load a good
build and dial these in across real rooms, voices, and background noise without
rebuilding, then lock in the winning values as defaults. Backed by BargeInTuning
(UserDefaults). Changes apply to the next session.

UnaMentis - Chatterbox Settings View
Advanced settings UI for Chatterbox TTS provider
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - Chatterbox Settings ViewModel
ViewModel for managing Chatterbox TTS settings with persistence
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - Discovery Progress View
Shows multi-tier discovery progress with animations
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - Help View
In-app help following iOS best practices
Provides user guidance for voice commands and app features

UnaMentis - Pocket TTS Settings View
Advanced settings UI for Pocket TTS on-device model
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - Pocket TTS Settings ViewModel
ViewModel for Pocket TTS settings UI
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - On-Device LLM Settings View
Settings UI for managing the on-device LLM model
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - On-Device Speech (STT) Status
=========================================
A Settings section that makes the on-device speech model fully observable:
whether a download was initiated, its live progress, and the result - plus a
control to (re)start it. Drop into any Form: `OnDeviceSpeechStatusView()`.

UnaMentis - QR Code Scanner View
Camera-based QR code scanning for manual server configuration
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - Server Settings View
UI for configuring self-hosted servers with auto-discovery
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - Settings View
Configuration and API key management
Part of UI/UX (TDD Section 10)

UnaMentis - Voice Cloning Views
Audio file picker and recorder views for voice cloning reference audio
Part of UI/Settings

UnaMentis - Voice Settings View
Consolidated voice model controls for STT, TTS, VAD, Audio, and LLM
Part of UI/Settings

- Speech Recognition (STT Provider)
- Language Model (LLM Provider, Model, Temperature, Max Tokens)
- Voice Output (TTS Provider, Voice, Speaking Rate, Chatterbox settings)
- Presets for quick configuration
